who: Demo client: Maya Chen. User need: “I want to compare my photos, choose my five favorites, leave any editing notes, and confidently send my selection to the pho
goal: Review shortlisted photos, edit notes, submit selection.
workflow: View selected photos in list with notes
Edit or remove photos from shortlist
Confirm submission is locked after submission
firstView: Shortlisted photo count and list of selected photos

sections.title: Selection Summary
sections.purpose: To show the number of selected photos and submission status.

sections.title: Selected Photos
sections.purpose: To display selected photos with notes in a list.

sections.title: Actions
sections.purpose: To provide submit and start over actions.

states.loading: Shows skeleton placeholders while loading selection data
states.empty: Displays empty state with message 'No photos selected yet'
states.error: Shows error alert with message 'Failed to load selection'
states.success: Displays selected photos and submission controls

responsive: List adjusts to single column on mobile, buttons stack vertically
accessibility: Keyboard navigation through list items and actions, screen reader labels for all interactive elements
